title: The Settling Chamber

features.name: crystallization-platform
features.desc-on-touch: A vast platform where all the motion has hardened into place. Here is where the doubt finally settled and became certainty again, but colder and more beautiful.

features.name: towers-of-old-arguments
features.desc-on-touch: Each tower is a debate frozen at the moment of reaching consensus. You can see the shape of the agreement in how the blocks stack. The arguments no longer move.

features.name: files-in-perfect-strata
features.desc-on-touch: Every file the archive ever stored is arranged here in layers. The oldest at the bottom, still unreadable. The newest at the top, already starting to dust.

features.name: moment-of-complete-stasis
features.desc-on-touch: Time stopped here to take inventory. You can see the exact instant motion ended and statistics began. The archive caught the corridor mid-thought, mid-question, and froze it.

features.name: dust-collected-at-the-center
features.desc-on-touch: Everything that didn't crystallize collects here. The dust is fine, colorless, still. It's the weight of all the words that have stopped being asked.

inscription: where the corridor learned to stop moving and call the stillness truth
